span.p:
1 · Capture
log each run: settings version,
input, answer, time, cost

div.style: color: rgb(38, 53, 40) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 220px; text-align: center; width: 220px;

span.p:
2 · Measure
daily scorecard, paired numbers
(on time % + promised time)

div.style: color: rgb(38, 53, 40) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 220px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Propose
owner idea, or a big AI model
reads the numbers weekly

div.style: color: rgb(38, 53, 40) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 220px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Test
replay past orders with
the new settings first

span.p:
5 · Promote
owner says yes · small trial ·
one-step undo

p.b: B · LAYA REPLACES JEV — our own decision model

div.style: color: rgb(38, 53, 40) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 220px; text-align: center; width: 220px;

Log every decision

chosen pick + its chance

Add the answer later

Train Laya

real data for the final test
